title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
description: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.

items.title: 3Dify: a Framework for Procedural 3D-CG Generation Assisted by LLMs Using MCP and RAG
items.content_text: Introduces 3Dify, a natural-language 3D graphics framework that operates creation tools through MCP and uses a computer-using agent for GUI operations when MCP is unavailable.
items.summary: Introduces 3Dify, a natural-language 3D graphics framework that operates creation tools through MCP and uses a computer-using agent for GUI operations when MCP is unavailable.

items.title: A Multimodal GUI Architecture for Interfacing with LLM-Based Conversational Assistants
items.content_text: Presents an MCP architecture that exposes an application's GUI navigation graph and view-specific tools to speech-enabled LLM assistants for voice interaction.
items.summary: Presents an MCP architecture that exposes an application's GUI navigation graph and view-specific tools to speech-enabled LLM assistants for voice interaction.

items.title: A Trajectory-Based Safety Audit of Clawdbot (OpenClaw)
items.content_text: Audits Clawdbot safety through logged action and tool-call trajectories across local execution and web-mediated workflows, using automated and human review.
items.summary: Audits Clawdbot safety through logged action and tool-call trajectories across local execution and web-mediated workflows, using automated and human review.

items.title: Agent Data Protocol: Unifying Datasets for Diverse, Effective Fine-tuning of LLM Agents
items.content_text: The agent data protocol (ADP) provides a shared format for agent training data across browsing, tool use, coding, and other tasks, including web agent workflows.
items.summary: The agent data protocol (ADP) provides a shared format for agent training data across browsing, tool use, coding, and other tasks, including web agent workflows.

items.title: Agent-Dice: Disentangling Knowledge Updates via Geometric Consensus for Agent Continual Learning
items.content_text: Agent-Dice fuses parameter updates to support continual learning in LLM agents, with GUI agent tasks evaluated alongside tool-use domains.
items.summary: Agent-Dice fuses parameter updates to support continual learning in LLM agents, with GUI agent tasks evaluated alongside tool-use domains.

items.title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI): Architectures, Taxonomies, and Evaluation of Large Language Model Agents
items.content_text: Surveys LLM agent architectures, operating environments and evaluation, covering web navigation and native computer use alongside other agent domains.
items.summary: Surveys LLM agent architectures, operating environments and evaluation, covering web navigation and native computer use alongside other agent domains.

items.title: Agentic Entropy-Balanced Policy Optimization
items.content_text: Introduces Agentic Entropy-Balanced Policy Optimization (AEPO), an RL method that adjusts rollout sampling and policy updates for tool-using web agents.
items.summary: Introduces Agentic Entropy-Balanced Policy Optimization (AEPO), an RL method that adjusts rollout sampling and policy updates for tool-using web agents.

items.title: Agentic Lybic: Multi-Agent Execution System with Tiered Reasoning and Orchestration
items.content_text: Introduces Agentic Lybic, a desktop automation system that routes tasks among GUI, code, and decision-support workers using a finite-state machine and evaluator.
items.summary: Introduces Agentic Lybic, a desktop automation system that routes tasks among GUI, code, and decision-support workers using a finite-state machine and evaluator.

items.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Step Rewards
items.content_text: Introduces iStar, a general agentic RL method that learns implicit step rewards; WebShop is one of several interactive benchmarks used to evaluate it.
items.summary: Introduces iStar, a general agentic RL method that learns implicit step rewards; WebShop is one of several interactive benchmarks used to evaluate it.

items.title: AgentPRM: Process Reward Models for LLM Agents via Step-Wise Promise and Progress
items.content_text: AgentPRM scores sequential agent decisions by their promise and progress toward a goal, with web shopping and browser navigation among the motivating tasks.
items.summary: AgentPRM scores sequential agent decisions by their promise and progress toward a goal, with web shopping and browser navigation among the motivating tasks.

items.title: ALLOY: Generating Reusable Agent Workflows from User Demonstration
items.content_text: Introduces ALLOY, which turns user demonstrations into editable, reusable workflows for LLM-based web agents carrying out preference-dependent tasks.
items.summary: Introduces ALLOY, which turns user demonstrations into editable, reusable workflows for LLM-based web agents carrying out preference-dependent tasks.

items.title: AppSelectBench: Application-Level Tool Selection Benchmark
items.content_text: AppSelectBench evaluates whether computer-using agents choose the right desktop application for a task, using generated user intents and multiple evaluation protocols.
items.summary: AppSelectBench evaluates whether computer-using agents choose the right desktop application for a task, using generated user intents and multiple evaluation protocols.

items.title: Are LLM Agents the New RPA? A Comparative Study with RPA Across Enterprise Workflows
items.content_text: Compares an agent using computer interfaces with UiPath RPA on enterprise data entry, monitoring, and document extraction, measuring speed, reliability, and development effort.
items.summary: Compares an agent using computer interfaces with UiPath RPA on enterprise data entry, monitoring, and document extraction, measuring speed, reliability, and development effort.

items.title: Beyond Clicking:A Step Towards Generalist GUI Grounding via Text Dragging
items.content_text: GUI-Drag provides synthesized text-dragging examples, while ScreenDrag benchmarks selecting text by dragging across varied GUI contexts.
items.summary: GUI-Drag provides synthesized text-dragging examples, while ScreenDrag benchmarks selecting text by dragging across varied GUI contexts.

items.title: Beyond Pipelines: A Survey of the Paradigm Shift toward Model-Native Agentic AI
items.content_text: Surveys model-native agentic AI and the role of RL in learned planning, tool use and memory, covering GUI agents as one application alongside deep-research agents.
items.summary: Surveys model-native agentic AI and the role of RL in learned planning, tool use and memory, covering GUI agents as one application alongside deep-research agents.

items.title: Blind Gods and Broken Screens: Architecting a Secure, Intent-Centric Mobile Agent Operating System
items.content_text: Analyzes security risks in screen-based mobile agents and proposes Aura, an agent runtime with structured interactions, app-agent isolation and mediated communication.
items.summary: Analyzes security risks in screen-based mobile agents and proposes Aura, an agent runtime with structured interactions, app-agent isolation and mediated communication.

items.title: Branch-and-Browse: Efficient and Controllable Web Exploration with Tree-Structured Reasoning and Action Memory
items.content_text: Branch-and-Browse is a web agent framework that uses tree-structured subtasks, web state replay, and page action memory to explore and complete tasks.
items.summary: Branch-and-Browse is a web agent framework that uses tree-structured subtasks, web state replay, and page action memory to explore and complete tasks.

items.title: BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents
items.content_text: BrowseSafe builds a benchmark of prompt injections in realistic HTML for browser agents and evaluates defenses against attacks that can affect agent actions.
items.summary: BrowseSafe builds a benchmark of prompt injections in realistic HTML for browser agents and evaluates defenses against attacks that can affect agent actions.

items.title: Can We Stop Malicious AI? KILLBENCH: A Benchmark for External AI Kill Switch Feasibility
items.content_text: KillBench evaluates external prompt-style signals intended to halt maliciously operating web agents, across harmful scenarios and agent configurations.
items.summary: KillBench evaluates external prompt-style signals intended to halt maliciously operating web agents, across harmful scenarios and agent configurations.

items.title: ColorAgent: Building A Robust, Personalized, and Interactive OS Agent
items.content_text: Presents ColorAgent, an operating system agent for long-horizon user instructions, trained with step-wise RL and self-evolving training and evaluated on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.
items.summary: Presents ColorAgent, an operating system agent for long-horizon user instructions, trained with step-wise RL and self-evolving training and evaluated on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

items.title: Computer Environments Elicit General Agentic Intelligence in LLMs
items.content_text: LLM-in-Sandbox gives agents a minimal computer environment for resource access, file management and code execution; LLM-in-Sandbox-RL trains models to use it.
items.summary: LLM-in-Sandbox gives agents a minimal computer environment for resource access, file management and code execution; LLM-in-Sandbox-RL trains models to use it.

items.title: Cross-Modal Content Optimization for Steering Web Agent Preferences
items.content_text: Introduces Cross-Modal Preference Steering (CPS), a black-box attack that edits a listing's images and text to steer VLM-based web agents' selections.
items.summary: Introduces Cross-Modal Preference Steering (CPS), a black-box attack that edits a listing's images and text to steer VLM-based web agents' selections.

items.title: CUARewardBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reward Models on Computer-using Agent
items.content_text: Introduces CUARewardBench for evaluating outcome and process reward models on annotated computer-use trajectories, plus Unanimous Prompt Ensemble (UPE) for reward judgments.
items.summary: Introduces CUARewardBench for evaluating outcome and process reward models on annotated computer-use trajectories, plus Unanimous Prompt Ensemble (UPE) for reward judgments.

items.title: D-Artemis: A Deliberative Cognitive Framework for Mobile GUI Multi-Agents
items.content_text: Introduces D-Artemis, a mobile GUI agent framework that retrieves app-specific tips, checks actions before execution, and reflects on their outcomes without trajectory training.
items.summary: Introduces D-Artemis, a mobile GUI agent framework that retrieves app-specific tips, checks actions before execution, and reflects on their outcomes without trajectory training.

items.title: DashboardQA: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Question Answering on Interactive Dashboards
items.content_text: Introduces DashboardQA to evaluate how vision-language GUI agents answer questions by interacting with dashboards, grounding elements, and planning actions.
items.summary: Introduces DashboardQA to evaluate how vision-language GUI agents answer questions by interacting with dashboards, grounding elements, and planning actions.

items.title: DECEPTICON: How Dark Patterns Manipulate Web Agents
items.content_text: DECEPTICON is an environment of 700 web navigation tasks that isolates dark patterns to measure how deceptive interface designs steer agent actions.
items.summary: DECEPTICON is an environment of 700 web navigation tasks that isolates dark patterns to measure how deceptive interface designs steer agent actions.

items.title: Demystifying deep search: a holistic evaluation with hint-free multi-hop questions and factorised metrics
items.content_text: Introduces WebDetective, a deep-search benchmark with a traceable Wikipedia sandbox, and EvidenceLoop, an evidence-tracking workflow for web-agent search and synthesis.
items.summary: Introduces WebDetective, a deep-search benchmark with a traceable Wikipedia sandbox, and EvidenceLoop, an evidence-tracking workflow for web-agent search and synthesis.

items.title: Detect Anything via Next Point Prediction
items.content_text: Introduces Rex-Omni, a general visual perception model trained for coordinate prediction; GUI grounding is one capability evaluated alongside detection and OCR.
items.summary: Introduces Rex-Omni, a general visual perception model trained for coordinate prediction; GUI grounding is one capability evaluated alongside detection and OCR.

items.title: Do Multi-Agents Dream of Electric Screens? Achieving Perfect Accuracy on AndroidWorld Through Task Decomposition
items.content_text: Minitap coordinates six specialized agents for AndroidWorld tasks, checking text input against device state and detecting action loops to revise its strategy.
items.summary: Minitap coordinates six specialized agents for AndroidWorld tasks, checking text input against device state and detecting action loops to revise its strategy.

items.title: Flash-Searcher: Fast and Effective Web Agents via DAG-Based Parallel Execution
items.content_text: Introduces Flash-Searcher, a parallel agent framework that organizes dependent subtasks as a graph and runs independent paths concurrently; it is evaluated on deep-search benchmarks.
items.summary: Introduces Flash-Searcher, a parallel agent framework that organizes dependent subtasks as a graph and runs independent paths concurrently; it is evaluated on deep-search benchmarks.

items.title: FocusAgent: Simple Yet Effective Ways of Trimming the Large Context of Web Agents
items.content_text: Introduces FocusAgent, which uses a lightweight LLM to select task-relevant lines from web agents' accessibility-tree observations, reducing context size and exposure to prompt injection.
items.summary: Introduces FocusAgent, which uses a lightweight LLM to select task-relevant lines from web agents' accessibility-tree observations, reducing context size and exposure to prompt injection.

items.title: FronTalk: Benchmarking Front-End Development as Conversational Code Generation with Multi-Modal Feedback
items.content_text: FronTalk benchmarks multi-turn front-end code generation from text and visual feedback; a web agent explores generated sites for evaluation and in AceCoder.
items.summary: FronTalk benchmarks multi-turn front-end code generation from text and visual feedback; a web agent explores generated sites for evaluation and in AceCoder.

items.title: General Agentic Planning Through Simulative Reasoning with World Models
items.content_text: Introduces SiRA, an agent architecture that uses a language-based world model to simulate action outcomes for planning in web-browser tasks.
items.summary: Introduces SiRA, an agent architecture that uses a language-based world model to simulate action outcomes for planning in web-browser tasks.

items.title: Genesis: Evolving Attack Strategies for LLM Web Agent Red-Teaming
items.content_text: Introduces Genesis, a red-teaming framework that generates adversarial injections for web agents and revises attack strategies using responses and interaction logs.
items.summary: Introduces Genesis, a red-teaming framework that generates adversarial injections for web agents and revises attack strategies using responses and interaction logs.

items.title: GhostEI-Bench: Do Mobile Agents Resilience to Environmental Injection in Dynamic On-Device Environments?
items.content_text: Introduces GhostEI-Bench, a benchmark that injects deceptive UI events into Android emulator workflows to assess mobile agents and analyze failures from actions and screenshots.
items.summary: Introduces GhostEI-Bench, a benchmark that injects deceptive UI events into Android emulator workflows to assess mobile agents and analyze failures from actions and screenshots.

items.title: Graph2Eval: Automatic Multimodal Task Generation for Agents via Knowledge Graphs
items.content_text: Introduces Graph2Eval, which generates multimodal agent evaluation tasks from knowledge graphs, including multi-step web interactions in Graph2Eval-Bench.
items.summary: Introduces Graph2Eval, which generates multimodal agent evaluation tasks from knowledge graphs, including multi-step web interactions in Graph2Eval-Bench.

items.title: GUI Knowledge Bench: Revealing the Knowledge Gap of VLMs in GUI Tasks
items.content_text: GUI Knowledge Bench tests knowledge of widgets, interactions, and procedures across six named platforms and 292 applications to assess VLMs used for GUI tasks.
items.summary: GUI Knowledge Bench tests knowledge of widgets, interactions, and procedures across six named platforms and 292 applications to assess VLMs used for GUI tasks.

items.title: GUI-Shepherd: Reliable Process Reward and Verification for Long-Sequence GUI Tasks
items.content_text: Introduces GUI-Shepherd, a process reward model trained on annotated GUI interactions to give step-level feedback for agent training and verification on AndroidWorld and AndroidControl.
items.summary: Introduces GUI-Shepherd, a process reward model trained on annotated GUI interactions to give step-level feedback for agent training and verification on AndroidWorld and AndroidControl.

items.title: GUISpector: An MLLM Agent Framework for Automated Verification of Natural Language Requirements in GUI Prototypes
items.content_text: Introduces GUISpector, an MLLM agent framework that operates GUI prototypes to check natural-language requirements and produces feedback for developers.
items.summary: Introduces GUISpector, an MLLM agent framework that operates GUI prototypes to check natural-language requirements and produces feedback for developers.

items.title: HarmonyGuard: Toward Safety and Utility in Web Agents via Adaptive Policy Enhancement and Dual-Objective Optimization
items.content_text: Introduces HarmonyGuard, a multi-agent framework that updates security policies and weighs safety against task completion for agents operating on the open web.
items.summary: Introduces HarmonyGuard, a multi-agent framework that updates security policies and weighs safety against task completion for agents operating on the open web.

items.title: How Smart Is Your GUI Agent? A Framework for the Future of Software Interaction
items.content_text: Proposes GUI Agent Autonomy Levels (GAL), a six-level framework for describing autonomy and benchmarking GUI agents that navigate web, desktop, and mobile software.
items.summary: Proposes GUI Agent Autonomy Levels (GAL), a six-level framework for describing autonomy and benchmarking GUI agents that navigate web, desktop, and mobile software.

items.title: ICA: Information-Aware Credit Assignment for Visually Grounded Long-Horizon Information-Seeking Agents
items.content_text: Information-Aware Credit Assignment scores intermediate information gathered by web agents, using rendered webpage snapshots to compare evidence across trajectories.
items.summary: Information-Aware Credit Assignment scores intermediate information gathered by web agents, using rendered webpage snapshots to compare evidence across trajectories.

items.title: Instruction Agent: Enhancing Agent with Expert Demonstration
items.content_text: Introduces Instruction Agent, a GUI agent that follows instructions extracted from one expert demonstration and uses verification and backtracking to handle interruptions.
items.summary: Introduces Instruction Agent, a GUI agent that follows instructions extracted from one expert demonstration and uses verification and backtracking to handle interruptions.

items.title: InternVL3.5: Advancing Open-Source Multimodal Models in Versatility, Reasoning, and Efficiency
items.content_text: Introduces InternVL3.5, a multimodal model family trained with Cascade RL and designed for more efficient inference; GUI interaction is among its stated capabilities.
items.summary: Introduces InternVL3.5, a multimodal model family trained with Cascade RL and designed for more efficient inference; GUI interaction is among its stated capabilities.

items.title: Learning Efficient Guardrails for Compliance
items.content_text: Introduces PolicyGuardBench for detecting policy violations in full web-agent trajectories and their prefixes, and trains PolicyGuard as an efficient guardrail model.
items.summary: Introduces PolicyGuardBench for detecting policy violations in full web-agent trajectories and their prefixes, and trains PolicyGuard as an efficient guardrail model.

items.title: LHAW: Controllable Underspecification for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.content_text: LHAW generates underspecified variants of long-horizon workflow tasks and uses agent trials to evaluate when missing information requires clarification.
items.summary: LHAW generates underspecified variants of long-horizon workflow tasks and uses agent trials to evaluate when missing information requires clarification.

items.title: LLMs as Scalable, General-Purpose Simulators For Evolving Digital Agent Training
items.content_text: Introduces UI-Simulator, which generates UI states and transitions for agent-training trajectories, and UI-Simulator-Grow, which prioritizes tasks and trajectory variants.
items.summary: Introduces UI-Simulator, which generates UI states and transitions for agent-training trajectories, and UI-Simulator-Grow, which prioritizes tasks and trajectory variants.

items.title: MalURLBench: A Benchmark Evaluating Agents' Vulnerabilities When Processing Web URLs
items.content_text: MalURLBench evaluates how LLM-based web agents handle disguised malicious URLs across attack scenarios; the paper also analyzes attack factors and proposes URLGuard.
items.summary: MalURLBench evaluates how LLM-based web agents handle disguised malicious URLs across attack scenarios; the paper also analyzes attack factors and proposes URLGuard.

items.title: Mano Technical Report
items.content_text: Introduces Mano, a GUI agent trained with simulated data, supervised fine-tuning, and offline and online RL, with a verification module for error recovery.
items.summary: Introduces Mano, a GUI agent trained with simulated data, supervised fine-tuning, and offline and online RL, with a verification module for error recovery.

items.title: MCP vs RAG vs NLWeb vs HTML: A Comparison of the Effectiveness and Efficiency of Different Agent Interfaces to the Web (Technical Report)
items.content_text: Compares HTML browsing, RAG, MCP, and NLWeb interfaces for web agents performing product search, comparison, and checkout tasks in four simulated e-shops.
items.summary: Compares HTML browsing, RAG, MCP, and NLWeb interfaces for web agents performing product search, comparison, and checkout tasks in four simulated e-shops.

items.title: Me-Agent: A Personalized Mobile Agent with Two-Level User Habit Learning for Enhanced Interaction
items.content_text: Me-Agent personalizes mobile agent behavior through a preference reward model and hierarchical memory for long-term and app-specific habits, and introduces User FingerTip.
items.summary: Me-Agent personalizes mobile agent behavior through a preference reward model and hierarchical memory for long-term and app-specific habits, and introduces User FingerTip.

items.title: Measuring Harmfulness of Computer-Using Agents
items.content_text: Introduces CUAHarm, 104 computer-use misuse tasks in a sandbox with verifiable rewards, and studies whether language models can monitor unsafe agent actions.
items.summary: Introduces CUAHarm, 104 computer-use misuse tasks in a sandbox with verifiable rewards, and studies whether language models can monitor unsafe agent actions.

items.title: Mixing Importance with Diversity: Joint Optimization for KV Cache Compression in Large Vision-Language Models
items.content_text: MixKV compresses vision-language model KV caches by balancing importance and diversity; its evaluations include GUI grounding alongside broader multimodal tasks.
items.summary: MixKV compresses vision-language model KV caches by balancing importance and diversity; its evaluations include GUI grounding alongside broader multimodal tasks.

items.title: MM-BrowseComp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents
items.content_text: Introduces MM-BrowseComp, a benchmark for browsing agents that must use evidence from web images and videos to answer multimodal search questions.
items.summary: Introduces MM-BrowseComp, a benchmark for browsing agents that must use evidence from web images and videos to answer multimodal search questions.

items.title: MMSearch-Plus: Benchmarking Provenance-Aware Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
items.content_text: Introduces MMSearch-Plus, a multimodal browsing benchmark with iterative image-text search, and an agent framework that marks and crops images for targeted retrieval.
items.summary: Introduces MMSearch-Plus, a multimodal browsing benchmark with iterative image-text search, and an agent framework that marks and crops images for targeted retrieval.

items.title: MUZZLE: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Web Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
items.content_text: MUZZLE evaluates web-agent exposure to indirect prompt injection by finding attack surfaces in agent trajectories and refining injected instructions from execution feedback.
items.summary: MUZZLE evaluates web-agent exposure to indirect prompt injection by finding attack surfaces in agent trajectories and refining injected instructions from execution feedback.

items.title: OdysseyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Complex Office Application Workflows
items.content_text: Introduces OdysseyBench for evaluating long-horizon workflows across office applications, plus HomerAgents to generate tasks from environment exploration and dialogue synthesis.
items.summary: Introduces OdysseyBench for evaluating long-horizon workflows across office applications, plus HomerAgents to generate tasks from environment exploration and dialogue synthesis.

items.title: Okara: Detection and Attribution of TLS Man-in-the-Middle Vulnerabilities in Android Apps with Foundation Models
items.content_text: Okara uses foundation-model-driven GUI agents to explore Android apps for TLS vulnerability detection, then applies instrumentation and classification to attribute vulnerable code.
items.summary: Okara uses foundation-model-driven GUI agents to explore Android apps for TLS vulnerability detection, then applies instrumentation and classification to attribute vulnerable code.

items.title: Permission Manifests for Web Agents
items.content_text: Proposes agent-permissions.json, a website manifest for declaring which interactions web agents may perform, with optional references to APIs.
items.summary: Proposes agent-permissions.json, a website manifest for declaring which interactions web agents may perform, with optional references to APIs.

items.title: PG-Agent: An Agent Powered by Page Graph
items.content_text: Introduces PG-Agent, which turns GUI operation episodes into page graphs and retrieves guidance from them to support task decomposition in new scenarios.
items.summary: Introduces PG-Agent, which turns GUI operation episodes into page graphs and retrieves guidance from them to support task decomposition in new scenarios.

items.title: PolySkill: Learning Generalizable Skills Through Polymorphic Abstraction
items.content_text: Introduces PolySkill, which separates a web-agent skill's goal from its execution so agents can learn and reuse skills across websites.
items.summary: Introduces PolySkill, which separates a web-agent skill's goal from its execution so agents can learn and reuse skills across websites.

items.title: Real-Time Procedural Learning From Experience for AI Agents
items.content_text: PRAXIS stores action outcomes and retrieves past state-action-result examples to guide agent decisions, with evaluation on the REAL web browsing benchmark.
items.summary: PRAXIS stores action outcomes and retrieves past state-action-result examples to guide agent decisions, with evaluation on the REAL web browsing benchmark.

items.title: Recon-Act: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Browser-Use System via Web Reconnaissance, Tool Generation, and Task Execution
items.content_text: Introduces Recon-Act, a browser-use framework that compares failed and successful web trajectories to create reusable tools for planning and executing long-horizon website tasks.
items.summary: Introduces Recon-Act, a browser-use framework that compares failed and successful web trajectories to create reusable tools for planning and executing long-horizon website tasks.

items.title: Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents
items.content_text: Introduces CUA-SHADE-Arena and a red-teaming workflow for testing monitors that detect covert misbehavior in computer-use agent trajectories.
items.summary: Introduces CUA-SHADE-Arena and a red-teaming workflow for testing monitors that detect covert misbehavior in computer-use agent trajectories.

items.title: ReSum: Unlocking Long-Horizon Search Intelligence via Context Summarization
items.content_text: Introduces ReSum, which compresses interaction histories during long web searches, and ReSum-GRPO, which trains agents to reason across the resulting segments.
items.summary: Introduces ReSum, which compresses interaction histories during long web searches, and ReSum-GRPO, which trains agents to reason across the resulting segments.

items.title: ReUseIt: Synthesizing Reusable AI Agent Workflows for Web Automation
items.content_text: Introduces ReUseIt, which synthesizes reusable web-agent workflows from successful and failed attempts and adds guards to detect and fix execution errors.
items.summary: Introduces ReUseIt, which synthesizes reusable web-agent workflows from successful and failed attempts and adds guards to detect and fix execution errors.

items.title: Say One Thing, Do Another? Diagnosing Reasoning-Execution Gaps in VLM-Powered Mobile-Use Agents
items.content_text: Introduces an evaluation framework for mobile GUI agents that compares actions implied by their reasoning with intended and executed actions to diagnose mismatches.
items.summary: Introduces an evaluation framework for mobile GUI agents that compares actions implied by their reasoning with intended and executed actions to diagnose mismatches.

items.title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
items.content_text: DreamGym synthesizes agent experiences with a reasoning-based environment model for online RL; its evaluations include the web task setting WebArena.
items.summary: DreamGym synthesizes agent experiences with a reasoning-based environment model for online RL; its evaluations include the web task setting WebArena.

items.title: Screen2AX: Vision-Based Approach for Automatic macOS Accessibility Generation
items.content_text: Introduces Screen2AX, which creates hierarchical accessibility metadata from macOS screenshots, plus datasets and Screen2AX-Task for desktop-agent evaluation.
items.summary: Introduces Screen2AX, which creates hierarchical accessibility metadata from macOS screenshots, plus datasets and Screen2AX-Task for desktop-agent evaluation.

items.title: See, Think, Act: Online Shopper Behavior Simulation with VLM Agents
items.content_text: Studies online shopper action prediction with VLM agents using webpage screenshots, HTML, and action history from OPeRA, trained with SFT and hierarchical RL rewards.
items.summary: Studies online shopper action prediction with VLM agents using webpage screenshots, HTML, and action history from OPeRA, trained with SFT and hierarchical RL rewards.

items.title: SheetBrain: A Neuro-Symbolic Agent for Accurate Reasoning over Complex and Large Spreadsheets
items.content_text: Introduces SheetBrain, a spreadsheet question-answering and manipulation agent that uses a Python sandbox and Excel tools, plus the SheetBench benchmark.
items.summary: Introduces SheetBrain, a spreadsheet question-answering and manipulation agent that uses a Python sandbox and Excel tools, plus the SheetBench benchmark.

items.title: SimGym: Traffic-Grounded Browser Agents for Offline A/B Testing in E-Commerce
items.content_text: SimGym runs traffic-grounded synthetic buyers as browser agents to compare e-commerce storefront variants offline, using buyer profiles derived from production interactions.
items.summary: SimGym runs traffic-grounded synthetic buyers as browser agents to compare e-commerce storefront variants offline, using buyer profiles derived from production interactions.

items.title: SmartSnap: Proactive Evidence Seeking for Self-Verifying Agents
items.content_text: SmartSnap trains GUI agents to collect concise screenshot evidence of task completion for an LLM judge, with experiments on mobile tasks.
items.summary: SmartSnap trains GUI agents to collect concise screenshot evidence of task completion for an LLM judge, with experiments on mobile tasks.

items.title: SSL: Sweet Spot Learning for Differentiated Guidance in Agentic Optimization
items.content_text: SSL uses progressively tiered rewards for agent training, including distance-based guidance on GUI perception tasks alongside planning and reasoning tasks.
items.summary: SSL uses progressively tiered rewards for agent training, including distance-based guidance on GUI perception tasks alongside planning and reasoning tasks.

items.title: State Your Intention to Steer Your Attention: An AI Assistant for Intentional Digital Living
items.content_text: Introduces an assistant that reads screenshots, application titles, and URLs to compare computer activity with a user's stated intention and send notifications when it diverges.
items.summary: Introduces an assistant that reads screenshots, application titles, and URLs to compare computer activity with a user's stated intention and send notifications when it diverges.

items.title: STEP: Success-Rate-Aware Trajectory-Efficient Policy Optimization
items.content_text: STEP allocates RL sampling by task success rate and trains on individual steps from interaction trajectories, with evaluations on OSWorld and AndroidWorld.
items.summary: STEP allocates RL sampling by task success rate and trains on individual steps from interaction trajectories, with evaluations on OSWorld and AndroidWorld.

items.title: Structuring GUI Elements through Vision Language Models: Towards Action Space Generation
items.content_text: Introduces IAML training, which augments coordinate samples to help multimodal models locate GUI elements from screen content and user instructions.
items.summary: Introduces IAML training, which augments coordinate samples to help multimodal models locate GUI elements from screen content and user instructions.

items.title: SWIRL: A Staged Workflow for Interleaved Reinforcement Learning in Mobile GUI Control
items.content_text: Introduces SWIRL, staged interleaved RL for mobile GUI control, pairing a Navigator that plans from screens and language with an Interactor that produces actions.
items.summary: Introduces SWIRL, staged interleaved RL for mobile GUI control, pairing a Navigator that plans from screens and language with an Interactor that produces actions.

items.title: TaskSense: Cognitive Chain Modeling and Difficulty Estimation for GUI Tasks
items.content_text: Cognitive Chain estimates GUI task difficulty by extracting sequences of cognitive steps from execution traces, then uses those estimates to assess GUI agents.
items.summary: Cognitive Chain estimates GUI task difficulty by extracting sequences of cognitive steps from execution traces, then uses those estimates to assess GUI agents.

items.title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
items.content_text: Terminal-Bench 2.0 benchmarks agents on 89 workflow-inspired tasks in computer terminal environments, with a distinct environment, human solution and verification tests for each task.
items.summary: Terminal-Bench 2.0 benchmarks agents on 89 workflow-inspired tasks in computer terminal environments, with a distinct environment, human solution and verification tests for each task.

items.title: UISim: An Interactive Image-Based UI Simulator for Dynamic Mobile Environments
items.content_text: Introduces UISim, an image-based mobile UI simulator that predicts the next screen layout after an action and renders the resulting screen for testing and data generation.
items.summary: Introduces UISim, an image-based mobile UI simulator that predicts the next screen layout after an action and renders the resulting screen for testing and data generation.

items.title: Understanding User Experiences of Computer Use Agents: Design Space and Opportunities for Building Agent UX Prototypes
items.content_text: Maps design considerations for computer-use agent experiences and introduces AgentUXlab, a browser-based probe for prototyping and evaluating agent UX on a website.
items.summary: Maps design considerations for computer-use agent experiences and introduces AgentUXlab, a browser-based probe for prototyping and evaluating agent UX on a website.

items.title: VeriWeb: Verifiable Long-Chain Web Benchmark for Agentic Information-Seeking
items.content_text: Introduces VeriWeb, a benchmark of long-chain web information-seeking tasks with verifiable subtasks and a complete human-annotated trajectory for each task.
items.summary: Introduces VeriWeb, a benchmark of long-chain web information-seeking tasks with verifiable subtasks and a complete human-annotated trajectory for each task.

items.title: Watch and Learn: Learning to Use Computers from Online Videos
items.content_text: Introduces Watch & Learn (W&L), which converts human computer-use videos into UI action trajectories by predicting actions between consecutive screen states.
items.summary: Introduces Watch & Learn (W&L), which converts human computer-use videos into UI action trajectories by predicting actions between consecutive screen states.

items.title: WebAggregator: Enhancing Compositional Reasoning Capabilities of Deep Research Agent Foundation Models
items.content_text: Introduces WebAggregator, a pipeline for synthesizing compositional questions from websites to train deep-research agents, plus the WebAggregatorQA testbed.
items.summary: Introduces WebAggregator, a pipeline for synthesizing compositional questions from websites to train deep-research agents, plus the WebAggregatorQA testbed.

items.title: WebATLAS: An LLM Agent with Experience-Driven Memory and Action Simulation
items.content_text: WebATLAS is a web agent that stores interaction outcomes and simulates candidate actions before acting, using past experience to plan navigation on unseen websites.
items.summary: WebATLAS is a web agent that stores interaction outcomes and simulates candidate actions before acting, using past experience to plan navigation on unseen websites.

items.title: WebGen-Agent: Enhancing Interactive Website Generation with Multi-Level Feedback and Step-Level Reinforcement Learning
items.content_text: Introduces WebGen-Agent for website code generation, using screenshot critiques and GUI-agent tests to refine code and provide step-level training rewards.
items.summary: Introduces WebGen-Agent for website code generation, using screenshot critiques and GUI-agent tests to refine code and provide step-level training rewards.

items.title: WebMMU: A Benchmark for Multimodal Multilingual Website Understanding and Code Generation
items.content_text: Introduces WebMMU, a multilingual benchmark for website visual question answering, element grounding, code editing, and mockup-to-code generation.
items.summary: Introduces WebMMU, a multilingual benchmark for website visual question answering, element grounding, code editing, and mockup-to-code generation.

items.title: WebOperator: Action-Aware Tree Search for Autonomous Agents in Web Environment
items.content_text: WebOperator uses tree search, action filtering, and path checks before replay to explore web tasks and backtrack while accounting for irreversible actions.
items.summary: WebOperator uses tree search, action filtering, and path checks before replay to explore web tasks and backtrack while accounting for irreversible actions.

items.title: WebRouter: Query-specific Router via Variational Information Bottleneck for Cost-sensitive Web Agent
items.content_text: Introduces WebRouter, a cost-aware router that compresses web-agent prompts to choose among LLMs, with cost and accuracy measured on WebVoyager websites.
items.summary: Introduces WebRouter, a cost-aware router that compresses web-agent prompts to choose among LLMs, with cost and accuracy measured on WebVoyager websites.

items.title: WebVIA: A Web-based Vision-Language Agentic Framework for Interactive and Verifiable UI-to-Code Generation
items.content_text: WebVIA combines a web UI exploration agent, interactive UI-to-Code generation, and validation of generated code's interactivity.
items.summary: WebVIA combines a web UI exploration agent, interactive UI-to-Code generation, and validation of generated code's interactivity.

items.title: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
items.content_text: AutoElicit iteratively revises benign instructions using execution feedback to surface harmful unintended actions by computer-use agents in OS workflows.
items.summary: AutoElicit iteratively revises benign instructions using execution feedback to surface harmful unintended actions by computer-use agents in OS workflows.

items.title: Where Not to Learn: Prior-Aligned Training with Subset-based Attribution Constraints
items.content_text: Proposes training with subset-based attribution constraints so models attend to intended evidence, evaluated on image classification and GUI-agent click decisions.
items.summary: Proposes training with subset-based attribution constraints so models attend to intended evidence, evaluated on image classification and GUI-agent click decisions.

items.title: World-Model-Augmented Web Agents with Action Correction
items.content_text: WAC has a web-agent action model consult a world model, simulate action outcomes and use judge feedback to correct actions before execution.
items.summary: WAC has a web-agent action model consult a world model, simulate action outcomes and use judge feedback to correct actions before execution.

items.title: Your Harness is Not Secure: Benchmarking Real-world Threat of Command Line Interface Agent
items.content_text: Introduces AdvCLI, a sandbox benchmark for evaluating whether command-line agents carry out security-relevant operating-system tasks across multiple hosts.
items.summary: Introduces AdvCLI, a sandbox benchmark for evaluating whether command-line agents carry out security-relevant operating-system tasks across multiple hosts.

items.title: A Systematic Literature Review of Automated Techniques for Functional GUI Testing of Mobile Applications
items.content_text: Surveys automated functional GUI testing techniques for mobile apps, comparing the effectiveness, efficiency and practicality of approaches reported in 25 studies.
items.summary: Surveys automated functional GUI testing techniques for mobile apps, comparing the effectiveness, efficiency and practicality of approaches reported in 25 studies.

items.title: A Training-Free, Task-Agnostic Framework for Enhancing MLLM Performance on High-Resolution Images
items.content_text: Introduces Extract Candidate then Predict (ECP), a training-free two-stage method for high-resolution images, evaluated partly on 4K GUI grounding.
items.summary: Introduces Extract Candidate then Predict (ECP), a training-free two-stage method for high-resolution images, evaluated partly on 4K GUI grounding.

items.title: Advancing Language Multi-Agent Learning with Credit Re-Assignment for Interactive Environment Generalization
items.content_text: Introduces CollabUIAgents, a multi-agent RL framework that assigns LLM-based process rewards to help agents generalize across interactive settings including mobile operations and web browsing.
items.summary: Introduces CollabUIAgents, a multi-agent RL framework that assigns LLM-based process rewards to help agents generalize across interactive settings including mobile operations and web browsing.

items.title: Agent Q: Advanced Reasoning and Learning for Autonomous AI Agents
items.content_text: Agent Q combines guided tree search, self-critique and preference-based fine-tuning to train web agents from successful and unsuccessful interactions.
items.summary: Agent Q combines guided tree search, self-critique and preference-based fine-tuning to train web agents from successful and unsuccessful interactions.

items.title: Agent-RewardBench: Towards a Unified Benchmark for Reward Modeling across Perception, Planning, and Safety in Real-World Multimodal Agents
items.content_text: Introduces Agent-RewardBench to evaluate step-level reward models for multimodal agents across perception, planning, and safety; web navigation is among its scenarios.
items.summary: Introduces Agent-RewardBench to evaluate step-level reward models for multimodal agents across perception, planning, and safety; web navigation is among its scenarios.
